purpose: Teach: チビ/見聞き/吐き出し/むき出し/ずらりと/自ずと/がんばら/追い込ん

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、弟をチビって呼んでたな
lines.en: Riku, you were calling your little brother 'Chibi,' weren't you?
lines.style: Teasing lilt on the question, like catching him in something small and kind. Light, playful edge. Eyes narrowed with affection, not malice.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、修学旅行で色々見聞きしたな、桜
lines.en: You picked up a lot on that school trip, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Soft challenge, almost curious. Turning it back on her with a slight smile. Not defensive—genuinely wondering what she saw. Measured pace.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ガムを吐き出してから話せよ
lines.en: Riku, spit out that gum before you talk to me.
lines.style: Exasperated but not harsh. The tone of someone who's said this before. Quick clip to the sentence. Automatic, like she doesn't need to think about it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、感情をむき出しにしすぎだぞ、桜
lines.en: You wear your feelings all over your face, Sakura. It's too much.
lines.style: Quiet, not unkind. Like he's noticed something she hasn't. Pause before the second sentence—searching for the right words. Gentle reproof, not criticism.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前ん家、トロフィーがずらりと並んでたな
lines.en: Riku, your place had trophies lined up everywhere.
lines.style: Slight wonder underneath the observation. Not envious—genuinely impressed, maybe a little surprised. Trailing into the memory of it. Soft landing on the final word.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、勉強すれば自ずと結果が出るぞ、桜
lines.en: You just study and the results come naturally, don't they, Sakura?
lines.style: Understated confidence. Not boasting—stating a fact he's noticed. Slight shrug in the voice, like it's obvious to him. Warm without being patronizing.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、テストでがんばらないと留年だぞ
lines.en: Riku, if you don't buckle down on these tests, you'll end up repeating the year.
lines.style: Serious, direct warning. No sugar-coating. Lean into the stakes. Brief pause before the consequence lands. She means it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、自分を追い込んで勉強してたな、桜
lines.en: You were pushing yourself really hard studying, weren't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Admiring recognition. Softer than before—he's seen something that matters. Slight warmth creeping in. Not interrogating, just acknowledging what he witnessed.
